news.title: Hengrui has become the go-to source of China biopharma innovation. What’s its secret?

The Jiangsu-based biopharma landed one of the largest licensing deals ever by a Chinese company courtesy of a head-turning $15.2 billion biobucks pact with Bristol Myers Squibb in May. At the same time, Hengrui has been quietly pioneering the transition from a straight-up licensor of innovation drugs to a co-developer that’s establishing NewCo entities with its Western partners.

papers.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation

We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. papers.title: VX-One: Typed, Calibrated Decision Heads for Real-Time Perimeter Triage - An empirical study of unknown-attack honesty, cascade gray zones, and calibration under drift
papers.summary: Perimeter triage faces a latency/semantics trade-off: signature engines are fast and format-safe but blind to unseen attacks, while generative models are semantic but slow and produce unparseable output. In late 2026 a class of commercial System One decision models (TypeSafe Jev; Microsoft-Decision-1) began selling typed decision primitives - binary gates, closed-set choices, ordinal scores - as product APIs, with no academic treatment.
